name: Spectator/Broadcast Mode
author: Kizi
description: Keep your race running after a crash and watch from the broadcast camera, or start the race parked in the garage. First part of the split AI Drive. Idea: Terminal Damage by nyannoying.

options.label: Watch: start by itself
options.description: Spectate automatically while AI Drive drives or after your crash, and stop when you race again.

options.label: Watch: move to a car still racing
options.description: If the camera is on your wreck or a car that retires, switch to a car that is still racing.

options.label: Keys: spectate key
options.description: Turns spectating on and off by hand (none = no key).

options.label: Keys: camera key after spectating
options.description: Pressed once when spectating stops so your camera goes back to normal. Set it to your change-camera key.

options.label: Window: keep the game running
options.description: The game keeps running and playing sound when you click another window, instead of pausing and muting.

options.label: Look: hide the game logo
options.description: Hides the F1 game logo in the spectator HUD's bottom-left corner. A change applies the next time you press Play.

options.label: Crash: keep the race running
options.description: The game does not end your race when your car is destroyed. The wreck stays and you watch the rest.

options.label: Crash: send my wreck to the garage
options.description: The wrecked car goes to its garage after this long and stays there. Needs "keep the race running".

options.label: Garage start: park me before the race
options.description: Your car is sent to the garage when the race session loads (setup and strategy) and you spectate from the start.

options.label: Garage start: park my teammate too
options.description: Also sends your teammate to the garage (the other car of your pair). Needs 'park me before the race'.

options.label: Telemetry: port the game sends to
options.description: The UDP port the game sends its telemetry to (Settings > Telemetry, format 2026). Used to find your teammate.

options.label: Telemetry: pass a copy to another addon
options.description: The game sends to one port only. To use Terminal Damage or SimHub too, set their port to this value and pick the same one here.

options.label: Debug: detailed log
options.description: Extra lines in the log for bug reports. Turn off if the game stutters.
